summary_en: The study tests ABSK-011, a medicine taken by mouth, in adults with advanced solid tumors, including advanced liver cancer. Patients take ABSK-011 once daily or twice daily in repeated 28-day cycles, after a single-dose run-in period; the total length of treatment is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics (how the body processes the drug), and it is a Phase 1 trial.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa ABSK-011, un medicamento oral, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de hígado avanzado. Los pacientes toman ABSK-011 una vez al día o dos veces al día en ciclos repetidos de 28 días, después de una dosis única inicial; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica en el registro. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerancia y la farmacocinética del medicamento (cómo lo procesa el cuerpo), y es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Male or female, aged 18 to 75 years.
Advanced solid tumor or advanced liver cancer that progressed on, did not tolerate, or has no standard therapy (escalation part).
Liver cancer at BCLC stage B or C with Child-Pugh score 5 to 6 (escalation) or 5 to 7 (expansion).
Expansion part: positive FGF19 overexpression test on archived tissue or biopsy, and at least one measurable lesion.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1 and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
not_for: Previous treatment with FGFR4 or pan-FGFR pathway inhibitors.
Known active brain or central nervous system metastases (stable cases may be allowed).
Liver tumor volume that is 50% or more of the whole liver.
Inability to take oral medicine or factors that significantly prevent drug absorption.
Active hepatitis C infection needing treatment, hepatitis B and C co-infection, or positive HIV test.
